@@U01540@@
But I know now that nothing perfect is given to man. You gave me this rapture that leads me nearer and nearer to the gods, but you gave me also the companion I can’t do without, even though he degrades me in my own eyes, cold, impudent, and in a single breath reduces your gifts to nothingness. He fans inside me incessantly the raging passion for that woman’s bewitching image. So I stagger from desire to pleasure, and having that, languish once more for desire.

@@U01542@@
(Entering.)

@@U01543@@
Haven't you had enough of this? How much longer can it please you? Trying something once is understandable, but then it’s time to go on.

@@U01545@@
I wish you had something more to do than plague me on one of my better days.

@@U01547@@
Oh, well, let’s make no mistake! I'd gladly just wash my hands of you! Just be careful not to say that to me in earnest. You aren't exactly an ideal companion, you know. You're rude, ill-tempered, and, what’s more, a lunatic. I’m never done with dealing with you! Nor can I ever tell from looking at you what you want and don’t want!

@@U01549@@
Ah! There! Now! There you've got it! Just the right tone! He wants to be thanked for boring me!
translation:
@@U01540@@
但我现在知道，人类没有什么是完美的。你给了我这种狂喜，让我越来越接近诸神，但你也给了我一个我离不开的伴侣，尽管他在我眼中贬低了我，冷酷无礼，一口气就把你的天赋降为虚无。他不断地在我内心煽动对那个女人迷人形象的强烈热情。因此，我从欲望到快乐摇摇欲坠，然后，我再次因欲望而变得憔悴。

@@U01542@@
（进入。）

@@U01543@@
你还没有受够这些吗？还能让你高兴多久？尝试一次是可以理解的，但之后就该继续了。

@@U01545@@
我希望你能有更多的事可做，而不是在我美好的日子里困扰我。

@@U01547@@
哦，好吧，我们不要犯错误！我很乐意和你洗手！只是要小心，不要认真地对我说这句话。你知道，你并不是一个理想的伴侣。你很粗鲁，脾气暴躁，而且还是一个疯子。我和你的相处还没有结束！我也无法从你的眼神中看出你想要什么、不想要什么！

@@U01549@@
啊！那里！现在！就这样，你得到了！语气刚刚好！他想感谢他让我厌烦了！
